title: Continue PR #1256 Decapod storage seam
intent: Continue PR #1256 by moving the canonical .decapod/data/decapod.db boundary to Dactyl. All canonical-store reads, writes, transactions, schema operations, migration/import, validation, and tests must use Dactyl APIs; Dactyl owns physical storage execution while Decapod retains schema, migration ordering, IDs, retry/governance policy, and domain semantics. Keep the Dactyl Issue #77 release status explicit and do not claim downstream release proof.
stop_conditions: Do not leave any canonical .decapod/data/decapod.db access on rusqlite or another direct SQLite handle. Do not claim Dactyl Issue #77 is released or merged until the user confirms it.

forbidden_paths: External credentials, production data, unrelated repository migrations, and direct mutation of .decapod state.
